name: When should I consider hiring a carpenter instead of a general handyman for home repairs?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider hiring a carpenter instead of a general handyman for home repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider hiring a specialized carpenter when your repair involves structural integrity, intricate woodcraft, or requires a deeper understanding of wood properties and construction techniques. While a handyman can handle minor fixes, a carpenter brings expertise in joinery, framing, and finish work, ensuring a durable and aesthetically pleasing repair. For instance, if you have a compromised support beam or need custom shelving, a carpenter's skill set is more appropriate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hire a carpenter for structural wood issues, intricate woodcraft, or complex repairs where specialized knowledge of wood is essential, rather than a general handyman.
